infographic.title: Which Gas Sensor for Which Hazard?
infographic.alt: Infographic matching gas hazards to the right types of gas sensors
steps: Catalytic bead or infrared sensors measure 0 to 100% LEL.
Electrochemical cells measure H2S, CO, Cl2 and NH3 in ppm.
Electrochemical oxygen cells warn of deficiency or enrichment.
Photoionisation detectors measure low ppm organic vapours.
